overview_description.description:
Slash is a hassle-free price-cutting plugin that lets you save money effortlessly while shopping online. Slash is the only extension that adds a unique checkout button to your favourite stores, giving you discounts on everything instantly. Now you can reduce prices at eBay, Booking.com, AliExpress, Currys, Groupon, M&S, and many more with one click and secure the best offers and deals!

Add Slash to your browser in seconds and continue shopping as usual. The Slash.com discount button will appear, automatically providing lower prices on ALL items - even items already on sale! You don’t have to do anything else. Just shop normally and save money. For the first time ever, you’ll get fair prices. Now, doesn’t that sound good?

Slash really is the zero-fuss way to cut prices WITHOUT the faff, stress, and wasted time of vouchers, coupon codes, and limited-time offers!

Slash is changing the way people shop online with its one-of-a-kind browser extension that provides instant price cuts directly inside your favourite stores. With Slash, you’ll never overpay for your shopping again. 

Install Slash now for FREE and enjoy unbeatable price reductions for life!

product.name: Slash Business Banking
product.description: A business banking platform providing checking accounts, ACH and wire transfers, virtual accounts, payment approvals, cash-flow visibility, and account management for entrepreneurs and growing businesses.

product.name: Slash Corporate Cards
product.description: Corporate Visa charge cards with virtual and physical card issuance, cashback, configurable spending limits, employee controls, transaction alerts, and centralized expense visibility.

product.name: Slash Stablecoin Payments
product.description: Business stablecoin payment functionality for sending and receiving USDC and USDT, with fiat-to-stablecoin and stablecoin-to-fiat conversion through integrated on- and off-ramps.

product.name: Slash Treasury
product.description: An integrated treasury and cash-management account that provides access to yield-generating money market investments for businesses managing excess cash.

product.name: Slash Working Capital
product.description: A business financing service offering access to partner-provided term loans and lines of credit for short-term liquidity and operating growth needs.

product.name: Slash Global USD Account
product.description: A USD financial account for eligible non-U.S. businesses to send and receive U.S. dollars and access selected Slash payment capabilities without a U.S. bank account or registered LLC.
